children: China environmental equipment maker's interim revenue rose 143% yr/yr for six months ended June
Net income attributable to owners rose 698% yr/yr for the reporting period
Board did not recommend payment of any dividend for the reporting period
The Group will invest in energy-efficient dust collection systems, automation and digital monitoring platforms
LARGE PROJECT COMPLETIONS – Revenue growth was primarily driven by several large-scale projects completed and recognised during the period
LOWER-MARGIN PROJECT MIX – Gross margin fell to 37.32% from 38.04% as revenue recognised came from relatively lower-margin projects
GROSS PROFIT INCREASE - Gross profit rose to RMB203.8 mln from RMB85.5 mln a year earlier, reflecting higher revenue and improved profitability
OTHER INCOME RISE - Other income increased to RMB13.2 mln from RMB7.5 mln a year earlier
The stock recently traded at 2 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 2 three months ago
